learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to grow healthy plants using nutrient-rich water instead of soil, and discover why this smart farming method is the future of sustainable agriculture!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Hydroponics is a modern farming skill where plants grow in water instead of soil. We mix special liquid plant food directly into the water so the roots can drink up exactly what they need!
Plants still need a strong base to stand up tall. Instead of soil, we use a clean growing medium like coco peat, clay pebbles, or small gravel stones to hold the plant roots safely in place.
Hydroponic farming uses up to 90 percent less water than traditional fields. Because we can stack plants vertically, we can grow fresh food indoors, in crowded cities, or even in spaceships!
Even without soil, the basic rules of nature apply. Your soil-less plants will always need plenty of bright sunlight, fresh air flow, clean water, and the right balance of nutrients to thrive.

fun_activity.title: 🌱 DIY Window Water Farm
fun_activity.instructions: Take a healthy cutting from a money plant or mint stem. Place it in a clear glass jar filled with fresh water near a bright window, and track its root growth over two weeks in your observation notebook!

quick_recap: ⭐ Hydroponics is the scientific method of growing plants using nutrient-rich water instead of soil.
⭐ Clean materials like gravel or coco peat are used as a medium to support the plant roots.
⭐ It is an eco-friendly vocational skill that saves massive amounts of water and space.
